# swarmops ref list

List every ref.

```yaml
title: "swarmops ref list"
description: "List every ref."
group: "refs"
since: "0.1.0"
mutates: false
identity_required: false
mcp_tool: "ref_list"
envelope_op: "ref_list"
exit_codes: [0]
errors: []
syntax: "swarmops ref list [OPTIONS]"
```

## Syntax

```text
swarmops ref list [OPTIONS]
```

## Required arguments

None.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

## Examples

### CLI

```sh
swarmops --repo [tmp]/store ref list
```

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "op": "ref_list",
  "api": 1,
  "result": {
    "refs": [
      {
        "name": "main",
        "target": "[c2]",
        "version": 2
      },
      {
        "name": "release/1.0",
        "target": "[c1]",
        "version": 1
      }
    ]
  },
  "meta": {
    "repo": "[tmp]/store",
    "elapsed_ms": "[elapsed_ms]",
    "resolved": {},
    "auth": "trust"
  }
}
```

Exit code 0. Recorded by the CLI tests. A name in square brackets, such as `[tmp]` or `[c1]`, stands for what differs from run to run: the test's temporary directory, an id, a time.

### MCP

No recorded example yet.

## Return information

`result` is a `RefListResp` (`swarmops schema RefListResp` prints its JSON Schema).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `refs` | `array of RefOut` | yes | The refs. |

Envelope `op`: `ref_list`.

Exit codes:

- `0`: Success.

## Errors

No golden step shows this command failing yet.

Any command that opens a store may also fail with a store error, such as [`E_NOT_A_REPO`](../errors.md#e_not_a_repo), [`E_IO`](../errors.md#e_io) or [`E_STORE_CORRUPT`](../errors.md#e_store_corrupt); a command line the grammar refuses is [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg) (exit 2).
